eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 7:10 PM on AUG 25, 2023 Effective until 7:10 PM AUG 26, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office is alerting residents in the Hauser Road area and points north for a voluntary evacuation order. Fire activity has picked up and is burning in a northern direction. We are not issuing a mandatory order at this time but we strongly suggest either leaving or packing a bag and be ready in case the situation deteriorates and the fire becomes worse.  Please use good judgement and make a smart decision. We have 2 shelters set up if you need a place to go. One at the First Methodist Church in DeRidder and one at the First Baptist Church in DeRidder. Be prepared to leave if a mandatory order is issued
